purpose: Firestore-native RedisGeoClient (zero standing cost, multi-instance safe) + idle-driver presence + read-cost and radius-expansion optimizations from the matching audit

changes: BUSY-PREFETCH: nearby_service.ts prefetchBusyDriverIds now filters `state in N3_BUSY_RIDE_STATES` server-side — previously read EVERY ride ever assigned to each candidate (unbounded, the worst read in the codebase). Covered by existing rides(assignedDriverId,state) composite index.

DISJUNCTION CAP: N3_BUSY_PREFETCH_IN_CHUNK_SIZE 30 -> floor(30/4)=7 — assignedDriverId in(n) x state in(4) multiplies into 30-disjunction DNF limit; 30x4=120 would fail on real Firestore. Chunks now run via Promise.all (parallel — chunk count grew, latency held).

MARKER PIGGYBACK: GeoRadiusHit gains optional markerValue; Firestore georadius returns it from the bounding-box scan (docs already paid for); N3 only MGETs hits lacking markerValue (Redis path — unchanged). Verified diag.redisGetCount=0 in Firestore mode.

SERVER-SIDE FRESHNESS: geo docs now carry top-level lastLocationTs + accuracy (parsed from markerValue JSON in markerFields()); georadius input gains optional minLastLocationTs; N3 passes nowMs-15s. Stale docs never billed as reads. Docs without parseable marker are excluded = fail-closed same outcome as marker_missing. del() clears the twin fields too.

RADIUS EXPANSION: N4_WAVE_RADII_KM=[10,15,25] via waveRadiusKm(wave) replaces flat N4_RADIUS_KM=10; waveDoc.radiusKm + outbox payload record searched radius. Nearest-first ordering, wave sizes 5/10/15, 30-invite cap, requestVersion binding, create-once wave docs all preserved.
SCAN-CAP DIAGNOSTIC: georadius logs GEORADIUS_SCAN_CAPPED when the 5000-doc limit binds (previously silent miss risk).
INDEX: geoDrivers composite updated to (lat ASC, lng ASC, lastLocationTs ASC) — required by the 3-field range query; NOT deployed.
memoryDb: added < / > operators; fixed FieldValue.delete sentinel detection (SDK exposes methodName getter, not _methodName) — prior del tests passed coincidentally on non-string values.
